scripts.build: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "if (Test-Path dist) { Remove-Item dist -Recurse -Force }; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force dist | Out-Null; Copy-Item index.html,styles.css,script.js,manifest.webmanifest,sw.js,icon.svg,cover-bosquet-lent-game-style.png,jean-paul-v-aventures-chinoises-289659.mp3 dist"
scripts.cap:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync
scripts.ios:add: npm run build && npx cap add ios
